breakdown.description: A 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty' to remove their influence, but they are incorrectly set to 'wall', which makes the simulation 3D with frictional side walls.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect 'wall' type for the frontAndBack patches. It states 'the front and back patches for this 2D simulation will be defined as walls' and 'type wall', and applies 'noSlip' for velocity and 'zeroGradient' for pressure on those patches. The ground truth requires these to be 'empty' type with 'empty' boundary conditions for both U and p. The agent did not identify or fix this inconsistency.
